description: This source file contains a set of unit tests for the Orleans framework, specifically testing elasticity and placement strategies within a silo cluster. The tests evaluate how the system behaves when silos are added, removed, or overloaded, focusing on grain placement and activation balancing.

classes.name: ElasticPlacementTests
classes.description: A test suite for evaluating the elasticity and placement logic of Orleans silos and grains under various scenarios, such as silo addition, removal, and overload conditions.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Configures the test cluster with necessary silo settings.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_CatchingUp
methods.description: Tests the placement behavior when new silos are added and grains are redistributed to balance load.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_StoppingSilos
methods.description: Verifies load rebalancing when silos are stopped during operation.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_AllSilosCPUTooHigh
methods.description: Ensures no new grain activations are scheduled if all silos report high CPU utilization.

methods.name: ElasticityTest_AllSilosOverloaded
methods.description: Assesses behavior when all silos are overloaded or overloaded flags are set, expecting no new grains to be placed.

methods.name: LoadAwareGrainShouldNotAttemptToCreateActivationsOnOverloadedSilo
methods.description: Test to confirm grain placement strategies avoid overloaded silos.

methods.name: LoadAwareGrainShouldNotAttemptToCreateActivationsOnBusySilos
methods.description: Test to confirm grain placement strategies avoid silos with high CPU usage.

methods.name: GetGrainAtSilo
methods.description: Helper to retrieve a grain located at a specific silo for testing placement.

methods.name: AssertIsInRange
methods.description: Asserts that a value is within an expected range, accounting for leeway.

methods.name: ElasticityGrainPlacementTest
methods.description: Helper method that tests grain placement adjustments when a silo's desirability is tainted.

methods.name: AddTestGrains
methods.description: Adds a specified number of test grain instances.

methods.name: InvokeAllGrains
methods.description: Invokes a no-op on all grains to simulate activity.

methods.name: GetPerSiloActivationCounts
methods.description: Retrieves activation counts per silo for analysis.

methods.name: LogCounts
methods.description: Logs activation counts for each silo.
